name: PDF Poster – let visitors read PDFs without leaving the page
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Embed brochures, eBooks, and documents directly in your posts and pages – visitors read them right on your site, with full-screen, print, and download at their fingertips.

PDF Poster | Documentation | Pricing | Support | Demo

Why PDF Poster?

Forcing visitors to download a PDF is friction. PDF Poster – trusted by over 20,000 users – embeds PDF documents directly into WordPress posts, pages, widgets, or templates in a responsive, accessible viewer that works across all devices. Share brochures, eBooks, business files, or portfolios where people can actually read them.

The plugin supports the Gutenberg block editor and includes customization for layout dimensions, full-screen mode, download and print buttons, filename display, and file display settings – plus content protection options in Pro.

Free Features

  • Responsive Width & Height: Fully customizable dimensions for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
  • Print Support: Let users print PDFs directly from the viewer.
  • Filename Display: Show the PDF file name clearly at the top.
  • Full-Screen Button: Enhance readability with a dynamic full-screen toggle.
  • Download Button: One-click download placed conveniently at the top.
  • Gutenberg Block Integration: Easily add PDFs using the block editor.
  • User-Friendly Viewer: Smooth scrolling and reading experience across all devices.

Pro Version

PDF Poster Pro adds features for advanced layout, control, and document protection.

Pro features include:

  • FlipBook Viewer: An interactive, book-like reading experience for your PDFs.
  • Raw PDF Viewer: Embed clean PDFs without black frames or toolbars.
  • Content Protection: Disable right-clicks and copying to safeguard your documents.
  • Preset Viewer Settings: Set default viewer preferences globally.
  • Shortcode Embedding: Use [pdf_embed] to place PDFs anywhere.
  • Classic Editor Tools: Quick embed tool and shortcode generator.
  • Additional Gutenberg Blocks: 2 extra blocks for more flexibility.
  • Sidebar Toggle Menu: Collapsible sidebar for easy navigation.
  • Full Control Over Buttons: Show/hide download and full-screen buttons, and translate their labels.
  • Jump to Page & Zoom Level: Open on a specific page with a predefined zoom.
  • Open in New Window & Popup Viewer: Open PDFs in a separate tab or a modal popup.
  • Google Doc Viewer: Bypass PDF block issues in some browsers.
  • Thumbnails & Horizontal Scrollbar: Thumbnail navigation panel and horizontal scrolling for wide PDFs.
  • Always Load the Latest Version: Ensure viewers always see the updated PDF file.
  • Show Only PDF: Hide the background and PDF menu for a distraction-free layout.
  • Slider and Scroll Viewer: Additional viewer display modes.
  • Annotation Mode & Link Behavior: Annotation mode and open-links-in-new-tab settings for the default viewer.

Try the PDF Poster PRO – Unlock all premium features now!

How to Use

  1. After installing, go to the PDF Poster menu in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Upload one or more PDF documents.
  3. Copy the shortcode shown in the editor or PDF list.
  4. Paste the shortcode into any post, page, or widget area.
  5. Hit Publish – enjoy your beautifully embedded PDF!

Using the block editor?

  1. Open a post or page and click the + icon (or type /pdf).
  2. Insert the PDF Poster block.
  3. Choose your PDF from the media library and hit Publish.

Live Demo | Get PDF Poster PRO

Shortcode Usage

[pdf_embed url=”https://example.com/document.pdf” width=”100%” height=”842px” print=”true” title=”My PDF Document” download_btn=”true” fullscreen_btn_text=”View in Fullscreen”]

Attributes:

  • url (required): The URL of the PDF file. Example: url="https://example.com/document.pdf"
  • width (optional): Width of the PDF viewer. Default: "100%"
  • height (optional): Height of the PDF viewer. Default: "842px"
  • print (optional): Display a print button. "true" or "false", default "false"
  • title (optional): Title displayed above the PDF viewer.
  • download_btn (optional): Display a download button. "true" or "false", default "false"
  • fullscreen_btn_text (optional): Text for the fullscreen button. Default: "View Fullscreen"

Use Cases

  • Businesses: Publish brochures, price lists, and company documents.
  • Authors & Publishers: Let readers preview eBooks and reports on-page.
  • Schools & Organizations: Share newsletters, forms, and schedules.
  • Portfolios: Present design work and case studies as embedded PDFs.

sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard (recommended):

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “PDF Poster”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Go to the PDF Poster menu to upload your first PDF, or add the PDF Poster block in the editor.

Manual installation:

  1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Use the shortcode on any page, post, or widget.
  4. To embed in theme PHP, place <?php echo do_shortcode('YOUR_SHORTCODE'); ?> in your template.
sections.faq:
How many PDF files can I embed using the PDF Poster plugin?

There are no limitations! You can embed an unlimited number of PDF files.

Can visitors download or print the embedded PDF?

Yes. You can show a download button and a print button in the viewer, and you can also disallow downloads – it’s totally in your control.

Does PDF Poster work with the Gutenberg block editor?

Yes. Add the PDF Poster block from the editor (or type /pdf), choose your PDF from the media library, and publish. A shortcode is also available for widgets and templates.

Can I make the viewer responsive for mobile devices?

Yes. Width and height are fully customizable per device – desktop, tablet, and mobile.

Can I embed an MS Office document?

No. But we have another plugin for embedding Office documents called Document Embedder.

Will this plugin work/be compatible with the theme I use?

This plugin is compatible with most themes. Unfortunately, we cannot check it against all third-party themes (especially paid ones), so there are cases when it may not work with a specific theme. We constantly check compatibility, and if we find that this plugin is incompatible with a third-party theme and we can fix it on our side, we release an update to fix the problem. If you find a conflict between our plugin and a third-party theme, please let us know and we will definitely release an update to fix it.

Will this plugin work/be compatible with other plugins that I use?

This plugin is compatible with most plugins. Unfortunately, we cannot check it against all third-party plugins (especially paid ones), so there are cases when it may not work with a specific plugin. We constantly check compatibility, and if we find an incompatibility we can fix on our side, we release an update to fix the problem. If you find a conflict between our plugin and a third-party plugin, please let us know and we will definitely release an update to fix it.

Where do I report security bugs found in this plugin?

Please report security bugs found in the source code of the PDF Poster plugin through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. The Patchstack team will assist you with verification, CVE assignment, and notify the developers of this plugin.
